evidence_class: simulation; the selection is a search over the finite grids FB_LAMBDAS and PID_GRID (sampled search)

design.reference: head: shaped reference a_r of design_fb.json on [0, T_xi), -a_b until v_r = 0; followers: constants only, desired clearance d_s,i from takeover (sim_bench_hr on a shaped setup)

protocol.source: run_bench_studies.py part fbtune (FB_LAMBDAS, score) and part base (PID_GRID); constants imported read-only; as run_hr_studies.py part retune
protocol.family: critically damped S2 feedback with one common gain lam for every unit, the head included: beta = lam^2, gamma = 2 lam; every other constant unchanged (alpha, detector, filter, input set, channel); the reference is not redesigned for the gain (the shaped reference of the design gain, or the unshaped reference)
protocol.training: ideal plant, doubled-increment takeover (increments doubled, head speed unchanged), filter on
protocol.heldout: ideal plant, benchmark takeover, filter on
protocol.objective:
Tuning objective of run_b2_ext._score with the requirements of the
    benchmark: a run with contact or an incomplete stop is rejected
    ([1e9, 1e9]); otherwise the number of violated requirements, then
    disp/1.0 + marker/3 + gap/1.
protocol.selection: lexicographic minimum of the training score, first in grid order on ties
protocol.feedback_note: 'feedback' is the proposed law ('proposed' and 'feedback' give identical runs on the shaped setup, proposed_vs_feedback_over_grid); its retuned gain is not certified
